name: Anadolu Kültür (Depo and Diyarbakır Arts Center)
known: Wikipedia calls Osman Kavala the founder and chair of its board, and the Sigrid Rausing Trust lists him among the founders.
Founder Osman Kavala has been jailed since 2017 and got a life sentence in 2022.

name: Arter
known: The collection, started in 2007, holds more than 1,300 works, about half by Turkish artists. Ömer Koç, a third-generation Koç and collector, chairs Arter, and Melih Fereli is director (The Art Newspaper).

name: Borusan Contemporary
known: The building is also the head office of Borusan Holding.
The museum sits in the holding's head office;
Ahmet Kocabıyık has chaired it since 2001.

name: Istanbul Biennial (İKSV)
known: The 18th edition, "The Three-Legged Cat", curated by Christine Tohmé, ran in three phases from 2025: the first from 20 September to 23 November 2025 at eight venues on the Beyoğlu to Karaköy axis (İKSV 2024 report, e-flux).
Kevser Güler has directed the Biennial since January 2024, after Bige Örer (2008 to 2024) (İKSV 2024 report). İKSV's board is chaired by Bülent Eczacıbaşı (Diken, Serbestiyet).
In September 2022 chairman Ömer Koç announced a 10-year extension of the 2007 to 2026 deal to 2036 (Diken).
Biennial sponsors are named and the trustees and directors are listed.

name: Istanbul Modern
known: Opened on 11 December 2004, founded by the Eczacıbaşı family.
Oya Eczacıbaşı chairs the board.
The sponsor panel names Oya Eczacıbaşı and Bülent Eczacıbaşı as founders.

name: Pera Museum
known: Founded by the Suna and İnan Kıraç Foundation and established on 8 June 2005 (Wikipedia).
The foundation's corporate page names İnan Kıraç as chair and İpek Kıraç as a founding member of its board.

Background on the founders: Suna Kıraç was the daughter of Vehbi Koç and worked at Koç Holding from 1961 to 2010, leaving as Vice Chair of its board; İnan Kıraç was chief executive of the Koç Group from 1994 to 1998 and then founded Kıraça Holding; İpek Kıraç has been a member of the Koç Holding boa

name: SALT Galata & SALT Beyoğlu
known: Founded by Garanti BBVA in 2011.
Founding director Vasıf Kortun served from 2011 to 2017, followed by Meriç Öner as Director of Research and Programs from 2017 to 2021 (Salt, History page).
Mimarlar Tasarım, founded by Han Tümertekin, refunctioned both buildings.

Salt general manager Deniz Ova thanked the founder Garanti BBVA for its support, and Garanti BBVA deputy general manager Ebru Taşcı Firuzbay is a Salt board member (Garanti BBVA release, 22 May 2026; translated from Turkish).

name: 421 Arts Campus (formerly Warehouse421)
known: Grants it gives out: an Artistic Research Grant of up to Dh75,000 for two or three artists a year in the Middle East, North Africa and South Asia region, and a Curatorial Development Exhibition Programme of up to Dh20,000 per applicant (The National, 16 May 2021).

name: Guggenheim Abu Dhabi
known: Mariët Westermann is director and CEO (Hyperallergic).

name: Ishara Art Foundation
known: Founded by Smita Prabhakar, its chairperson (Ishara).
The Ishara site names Sasha Altaf as director.
The same article names her as director of the AMS International Group.

Khaleej Times (6 May 2017) names her also as president of Lazer Capital, whose management team leads projects in infrastructure, oil and gas, agriculture, technology, power and utility, real estate and construction, and as CEO of Apsons International, a trading company.
Abdelmonem Alserkal, founder of Alserkal Avenue, is honorary chairman of the trustees (Ishara;
Trustees (Ishara): Abdelmonem Alserkal (Honorary Chairman), Hoda Barakat, Mustafa Al Hashimi, Ahmed Bin Shabib, Rashid Bin Shabib and Abdulfattah Sharaf.

name: Jameel Arts Centre
known: Named for its founder Art Jameel, which was established in 2003 as part of Community Jameel (Art Jameel).

name: Tashkeel
known: Founder: Sheikha Lateefa bint Maktoum bin Rashid Al Maktoum established it in 2008 (Art Dubai listing, tashkeel.org).
ENOC's Group CEO describes it as "a wholly-owned entity of the Government of Dubai" (HiDubai Focus), and Wikipedia describes it as a state-owned energy group in the oil, gas and coal industry.
The about page names founder Sheikha Lateefa bint Maktoum and the team page lists staff only.

name: Sharjah Art Foundation
known: Director Jack Persekian was dismissed that month.
